name: Wonton or Ramen Noodle Broth Bowl
whyItWorks: Hot bone broth hydrates an irritated bowel and replaces sodium, while refined wheat noodles and thin wonton wrappers require almost zero digestive effort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer ramen noodles (ditch spicy chili packets) or frozen chicken/pork wontons in rich chicken bone broth. Add 1 drop toasted sesame oil and a soft-boiled egg.
